runtime: tools/build_manila_stream_shards.py imports building polygons and available attributes only from buildings.geojson; it never reads Manila building-details.geojson, building-footprints.geojson, Overture building extracts, or the PBF building layer. OpenMapTiles PBF is used only for road geometry and non-building POIs; transportation.geojson supplies street names.

photo_facade_textures.status: No human-verified building/photo matches are currently available; no candidate photo may be assigned automatically.

building_source.runtime_role: sole source of Manila local building footprints and mapped building attributes

street_source.runtime_role: always imported for named street-label geometry; labels overlay PBF road surfaces without replacing them
